thread:
sam: Postmortem posted for the authz outage. Root cause: token validation edge-case + stale permission map during a partial deploy. Audit sink missed ~6 minutes of events during rollback.
sre-bot: Incident ticket created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2935001234 1: status=postmortem, sev=P2
sam: We need a compact follow-up tracker here. I propose 4 deliverables: (A) token validation suite + CI gating, (B) permission-map invariant checks + deploy-time guard, (C) audit-sink reliability + backfill plan, (D) secrets TTL/rotation verification + alerting. Assign below.
june: I'll take (A) token validation suite. Plan: add unit tests, integration replay against KV cache, and a CI job that fails the PR if critical cases regress. ETA: 8 business days. Will include expired-token and rotate-concurrency scenarios.
li: I'll own (C) audit-sink. Action items: add checksum/heartbeat emitter on producers, implement missing-event alert if gap > 1m, and draft backfill steps for historical window. ETA: 6 business days.
ops: I'll take (D) secrets TTL/rotation verification. Building an inventory + k8s CronJob scanner and Prometheus metric `secrets_ttl_drift_total`. Alert if >1% drift in any namespace. ETA: 5 business days. Will file tracker.
sam: I'll cover (B) permission-map invariants and deploy guard. Idea: pre-deploy job that validates mapping diffs against a whitelist, and block if >0 failing mappings for high-priv roles. ETA: 7 business days.
june: CI vs nightly question: prefer fast smoke in PRs plus nightly full-replay. Add a `--replay-seed` to make results reproducible.
sam: Agreed. Suggested CLI:
```
./devtools/authz-harness --smoke
./devtools/authz-harness --nightly --replay-seed=abc123
```
june: Will add a GH Action `authz-harness.yml` and wire to merge gating for platform components.
li: For audit-sink, is there an existing retention SLA? I couldn't find it in docs.
ops: Current infra logging retention is 90 days for heavy events, 30 days for debug. If backfill beyond retention is needed we need to pull from backup storage. I'll coordinate with infra backups.
security: Suggest adding audit schema versioning and a consumer contract test. That would catch producer changes that broke sink parsing.
li: Good call. I'll start a schema contract test and add it to the producer CI.
ops: Tracker created: https://redwood.internal/trackers/SEC-AUTHZ-2935. Added checkboxes and owners.
sre-bot: Noted recurring pattern: audit gaps + secrets drift seen in 4 of 7 incidents YTD. Recommend a monthly regression digest to SRE/Product.
sam: Process asks: 1) link PRs and tracker tickets to this thread; 2) make the follow-up meeting 2 weeks out and reserve 30m to verify deployed fixes; 3) convert any long-term items into backlog epics. I'll schedule meeting for 2024-12-05 16:00 UTC.
june: I'll open PRs today and link them here. Draft PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inc/platform/pull/9588 (harness) and https://github.com/redwood-inc/auth-service/pull/342 (invariant checks).
li: Audit schema doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit/schema-2024-12.md. Added `event_id` and `producer_id` as required fields. Will update consumer tests.
ops: CronJob for TTL scanning deployed to staging. PoC metrics exposed: `secrets_ttl_drift_total` and `secrets_rotation_failures_total`.
security: Will draft a runbook escalation: if rotation failures >= 3 within 24h escalate to Sec oncall and open a hotfix channel.
sre-bot: Added weekly telemetry job to watch for audit gaps > 30s and a pager duty rule for missing-events threshold.
sam: Owners, please ping in this thread when you have PRs merged, alerts wired, or playbook updates. We'll close items once all PRs are linked to the tracker and passing in prod for 72h.
june: PR opened and linked: https://github.com/redwood-inc/platform/pull/9588. CI badge is failing on a flaky test, investigating.
li: Contract tests in place and passing on producer CI. Created follow-up issue for backfill steps.
ops: TTL scanner promoted to prod; dashboards added to `dashboards/authz-health.json`. Pager alert rule created in PagerDuty.
sre-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled by sam for 2024-12-05 16:00 UTC. Reminder will post 48h before.
sam: Thanks all. Noting priority: A (token harness) high, B (perm invariants) high, C (audit reliability) medium-high, D (secrets verification) high. Reassign if blocked. :thumbsup:
june: Will update this thread when tests are stable and CI green.
li: I'll post back when backfill run is validated.
ops: Tracker updated with prod verification checklist. Closing assignment phase.
